title: Rain Bird Zone Runtime vs ET Forecast
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume/Flo/HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rainbird:zone
join et [search index=personal sourcetype=ecowitt:obs]
where runtime_min>et_min*1.5
description: Compares Rain Bird watering runtime to evapotranspiration forecast.
value: Surfacing rain bird zone runtime vs et forecast helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant water, plumbing & utilities export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It treats when rain bird zone runtime vs et forecast matters for your routine.
